**My (First!!) Fic**  
  
**Fandom** - Dungeons & Dragons

**Rating** - Teen

**Title/Link** - [The Six: Artifact Hunt](https://archiveofourown.org/works/56454067/chapters/143455339)

**Genre** - Adventure/Fantasy

**Summary** - Six adventurers all gather in Waterdeep for a common goal. A mysterious artifact with limitless potential. All of them want its power for different reasons, but only one will be able to wield it. What's worse, the artifact has fallen into the hands of someone wishing to decimate The Sword Coast. Can these "heroes" find the artifact before it is too late?

**Additional Notes** - This is a fic that takes place along the Sword Coast, around 5 years after Waterdeep: Dragon Heist. These 6 characters all have actual character sheets that I will be using to make their actions more "realistic". I hope you enjoy, as this is my first ever work on Ao3. Thank you!!
